newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: India cancels November diesel import tender.
newsitem.headline: India cancels November diesel import tender.

text.p: State-owned Indian Oil Corp (IOC) has cancelled its tender to import high speed diesel tender for delivery in November due to port congestions, traders said on Tuesday.
"We have just received a telex from IOC a few minutes ago confirming the cancellation," one trader said.
This is the first time that IOC has cancelled its diesel tender this year. It had already cancelled the monthly kerosene import tender at least twice this year, traders said.

The cancellation of this latest diesel tender, which was scheduled to close on September 19, came on the heels of IOC's extremely small purchase of 120,000 tonnes of diesel in its previous tender for October delivery cargoes.
Port congestions were also cited as the reason for the cap in imports the previous tender.
